high_level_description: The image is a simple black background with white text centered in the middle. The text reads "Ars longa, vita brevis." This Latin phrase translates to "Art is long, life is short," which is a common saying that emphasizes the value of time and the importance of making the most of it. There are no people, objects, or any other elements present in the image. The setting is minimalistic, focusing solely on the text against the black background.
